units.source_text: 薰大将为浮舟举办七七的法事，却又怀疑她是否真个死去。

en.t: Kaoru the Captain held the forty-ninth-day memorial service for Ukifune, yet he still wondered whether she had truly died.

units.source_text: 但念无论死或不死，做功德总不是坏事。

en.t: But he thought that, whether she was dead or alive, performing meritorious rites could do no harm.

units.source_text: 于是十分秘密地在宇治那律师的寺中大做道场。

en.t: So he very secretly arranged a grand Buddhist service at that Vinaya master's temple in Uji.

units.source_text: 命令办事人：赠与六十位法师的布施品必须从丰。

en.t: He ordered the attendants in charge that the offerings given to the sixty monks must be generous.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲也来到宇治，另外添办几种佛事。

en.t: Ukifune's mother also came to Uji and added several other Buddhist rites of her own.

units.source_text: 匂亲王将黄金装入白银壶中，送到右近处。

en.t: Prince Niou placed gold in a silver jar and sent it to Ukon.

units.source_text: 他深恐外人怀疑，不便公然为浮舟大办法事，这黄金只当作是右近供养的。

en.t: Because he deeply feared outsiders' suspicions and could not openly hold a grand memorial for Ukifune, the gold was treated simply as Ukon's offering.

units.source_text: 不悉内情的人都说：“为什么这侍女的供养那么阔绰？”

en.t: People who did not know the circumstances all said, "Why is this maid's offering so lavish?"

units.source_text: 薰大将方面，派遣了一大批亲信的家臣到山寺来办事。

en.t: On Kaoru the Captain's side, he sent a large group of trusted retainers to the mountain temple to manage the arrangements.

units.source_text: 有许多人惊诧地说：“真奇怪！这女子从未闻名，何以法事做得如此体面？她毕竟是何等样人？”

en.t: Many people said in amazement, "How strange! This woman was never known by name, so why is her memorial being conducted with such dignity? What sort of person was she after all?"

units.source_text: 此时常陆守也来了，他毫不客气地以主人自居。

en.t: At this time the Governor of Hitachi also arrived, and without the least reserve he behaved as though he were the host.

units.source_text: 众人看了都觉得奇怪。

en.t: Everyone who saw this found it strange.

units.source_text: 常陆守近来因女婿少将生了儿子，大办庆祝，忙得不亦乐乎。

en.t: Recently, because his son-in-law the Lesser Captain had had a son, the Governor of Hitachi had been holding grand celebrations and was delightedly busy.

units.source_text: 他家中珍宝几乎应有尽有，近又收集了唐土和新罗的种种物品。

en.t: His house already had almost every kind of treasure, and recently he had gathered various objects from China and Silla as well.

units.source_text: 然而身份所限，这些物品毕竟甚不足观。

en.t: Yet because his rank was limited, these things were, in the end, not very impressive.

units.source_text: 这法事本来是秘密举办的，然而排场非常盛大。

en.t: This memorial service had originally been held in secret, yet its scale was extremely grand.

units.source_text: 常陆守看了，想道：“浮舟如果在世，其命运之高贵决非我等所能并比！”

en.t: Seeing it, the Governor of Hitachi thought, "If Ukifune were alive, the nobility of her fate would be far beyond anything we could compare with."

units.source_text: 匂亲王夫人也送来种种布施物品，又命设筵宴请七僧。

en.t: Prince Niou's wife also sent various offerings and ordered that a banquet be prepared to entertain seven monks.

units.source_text: 皇上也闻知了薰大将曾有如此一情妇，设想他对此人情爱甚深，未便使二公主知道，所以一向隐藏在宇治山中，觉得他很可怜。

en.t: The Emperor also heard that Kaoru the Captain had once had such a mistress, and imagining that his affection for her had been very deep, and that he had kept her hidden in the mountains of Uji because it was inconvenient to let the Second Princess know, he felt sorry for him.

units.source_text: 薰大将与匂亲王二人心中，一直为浮舟悲伤。

en.t: In their hearts, both Kaoru the Captain and Prince Niou continued to grieve for Ukifune.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在情火炽盛之时忽然失去了恋人，更是非常痛心。

en.t: Prince Niou had suddenly lost his beloved while the flames of passion were still blazing, and this made his pain all the deeper.

units.source_text: 然而他原是浮薄成性的人，为欲安慰悲情，试向别的女子求爱的事又多起来。

en.t: Yet he was frivolous by nature, and in trying to soothe his sorrow he again began making more attempts to court other women.

units.source_text: 薰大将则身任其咎，虽然多方照顾了浮舟的遗族，还是难于忘怀这莫可挽回的恨事。

en.t: Kaoru the Captain, for his part, took the blame upon himself, and although he cared for Ukifune's surviving family in many ways, he still found it hard to forget this irreparable sorrow.
